premise.claim: Three claims from the PR body: (1) 'A missing target RoleBasedGroup is an unrecoverable one-shot failure' (Failed/InvalidTarget even if the target is created moments later); (2) 'An existing target RBG whose Pods are not scheduled yet reports Completed/NoNodesMatched' (silent false success); (3) '#466's customized-container-image CEL rule freezes pre-existing objects' on Kubernetes <= 1.32 (status subresource strategy runs CEL without ratcheting).
premise.evidence: P0-1/P0-2: results/unit-premise-base.txt (base 35e5d029: missing target -> Failed/InvalidTarget no-requeue; unscheduled pods -> Completed/NoNodesMatched). P0-3: results/envtest-1.31.txt (status write on pre-existing invalid object REJECTED with the CEL message under the base CRD) and results/envtest-1.33.txt (same write ACCEPTED on 1.33 -> the ratcheting version boundary is real).
